_note: Hand-curated gold CL terms for hECA skin labels. Assigned from each cluster's 50-gene marker set under the rule used for the other seven organs: the label is visible but is not evidence, and where the markers contradict it the markers decide. null is an explicit abstention, not a miss.
_curated: 2026-08-21; markers read per cluster, CL release 2026-06-08
_disagreements: Schwann cell -> keratinocyte: top markers are KRT6A/KRT6B/KRT77, not glial. Vascular smooth muscle cell -> pericyte: KCNJ8 and COX4I2 are pericyte markers; CellTypist reads the same cluster as pericyte. ILC -> gamma-delta T cell: TRDC and TRBC1 are TCR constant genes and ILCs carry no rearranged TCR. Conventional dendritic cell (1,280 cells) -> plasmacytoid dendritic cell: IRF7 and CCDC50. Enteric glial cell -> Schwann cell: MPZ is myelin protein zero, and enteric glia in skin is anatomically implausible. Muscle satellite cell: label is right, the mapping was not -- MYF5/FGFR4 are skeletal, so CL:0000594 rather than the smooth muscle myoblast the resolver reached.
_abstentions: Lymphoid cell and Myeloid cell: top markers are snoRNAs and pseudogenes (SNORD100, EEF1A1P5, SNORA70) -- a technical artifact rather than a cell type. Dendritic cell, NK T cell, Memory CD8 T cell, Muscle cell and Macrophage dendritic cell progenitor: markers too weak or generic to decide.
